description: This file defines an interface class 'ISessionManagementServer' for session management in a media server IPC module. It declares virtual methods for initializing, starting, stopping, and setting log levels for the session management server.

classes.name: ISessionManagementServer
classes.description: An interface class for session management server operations, including initialization, control, and log level configuration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session management server with a socket name and permissions.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets various debug log levels for the server.
